en-US.shortDescription: Household memory, tasks, briefings, and plans you approve before they start.
en-US.fullDescription:
AGORA+ is a household brain you run yourself. Ask it what someone is allergic to, what is due today, or what the house already decided. Tell it a fact to keep, a task to add, or a week of dinners to plan.

Keeping a fact, adding a task, and the morning briefing happen in your home. Forgetting a fact or starting a plan waits until you say yes. The spoken answer stays short. Lists, receipts, and the written plan stay on screen.

Facts, tasks, and finished plans stay in the data folder you choose. People who can open that home, or who have its token, can read them. The privacy policy and terms linked from this listing describe that home. They are not an Amazon privacy policy.

This add-on connects to the household you host over HTTPS. It does not ship a model of its own. Web lookup and spoken audio use the keys you set for that home, or they say they are not set up.
examplePhrases: Ask AGORA what Mia is allergic to
Tell AGORA to plan dinners for this week
Tell AGORA the spare key is in the kitchen drawer
